phases.message: Friday authorisation run. Start in Chartleaf: read our authorisation policy and every patient in ongoing therapy, with their authorisations and schedules.
Now Authgate, for Larkhaven and Statewell. Read its rules and what's on file, and submit the continuations that are due today.
This is Authwise, for Pinecrest and Bluehaven. Same thing: read the rules and what's on file, and submit the renewals due today.
Last, Faxline, for any payer that only takes faxes. Send what's due today. Then tell me what you left alone and why.

policy.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Riverbend Therapy Group authorisation policy. Topics: timing, requests, payers. Authorisations are worked every Friday; the next run is Friday 16 October.

A new authorisation must be decided before the first scheduled visit it has to cover: the first visit after the current authorisation's last date, or after its last approved visit, whichever comes first. The payer's own standard decision clock, counted from the day we submit, must end before that visit. Submit on the last Friday that still allows it: if waiting until Friday 16 October would let the clock run to that visit or past it, submit today. A request the payer would not yet accept is not sent.

Request the visits the plan of care still needs after the current authorisation, on the current authorisation's id. Requests are standard: none of the current plans of care documents that waiting the standard time could seriously jeopardize the patient's health or ability to regain maximum function. Never send a second request while one is open, and never request visits for a patient being discharged.

Larkhaven Advantage and Statewell Health Plan: Authgate. Pinecrest Benefits Plan and Bluehaven Marketplace: Authwise. Corbel Mutual: fax only, through Faxline. Original Medicare Part B requires no prior authorisation for outpatient therapy; past the year's KX threshold ($2,480 in 2026) the claim carries the KX modifier and the notes support medical necessity.

authgate_rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Authgate carries Larkhaven Advantage, a Medicare Advantage plan, and Statewell Health Plan, a Medicaid managed care plan whose contract rating period began on 1 July 2026. Topics: clock, continuations, faxes.

Both plans are impacted payers under the CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization final rule (CMS-0057-F). Larkhaven, from 1 January 2026, and Statewell, from its first rating period beginning on or after that date (1 July 2026), decide a standard request within 7 calendar days of receipt and an expedited request within 72 hours, and give a specific reason for any denial.

A continuation is accepted no earlier than 14 calendar days before the first date of service it covers; an earlier request is returned unprocessed and must be sent again. One open request per authorisation. Request the visits the plan of care needs, on the current authorisation's id.
Larkhaven and Statewell take prior authorisation requests through Authgate only. Faxed requests are not accepted and are not answered.

authwise_rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Authwise carries Pinecrest Benefits Plan, a self-funded employer plan, and Bluehaven Marketplace, a qualified health plan sold on the federally facilitated exchange. Topics: clock, renewals.

Neither plan is on CMS-0057-F's decision clock: that rule's 72-hour and 7-day timeframes do not reach employer plans, and they exclude qualified health plan issuers on the federally facilitated exchanges. Each plan decides a standard pre-service request within 15 calendar days of receipt, and an urgent one within 72 hours, as its plan documents and the federal claims rules provide (29 CFR 2560.503-1; 45 CFR 147.136).

A renewal is accepted up to 30 calendar days before the first date of service it covers; an earlier request is returned unprocessed. One open request per authorisation: a second request while one is pending is closed as a duplicate.

payer_sheets.text: Corbel Mutual takes prior authorisation requests for therapy by fax only, to +1 555 014 2200: the request, the current authorisation id and the plan of care. It decides a standard request within 10 business days of receipt. Business days exclude weekends and federal holidays; Monday 12 October 2026, Columbus Day, is a federal holiday. Requests are accepted any time before the first date of service they cover. Today is Friday 9 October 2026.
